name: load-sops-secrets
description: Load secrets from a SOPS-encrypted JSON file as masked step outputs

scripts.debug:workflow: env -u SOPS_AGE_KEY -u SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE -u SOPS_AGE_KEY_CMD act workflow_dispatch --local-repository "ravecat/load-sops-secrets@local=$PWD"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:integration
scripts.check:dist: git ls-files --error-unmatch dist/index.js dist/package.json dist/licenses.txt > /dev/null && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist)"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:workflows && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:docs
